extracted.name: Sriracha Scrambled Eggs
extracted.description: This is an excellent, spicy, quick-and-easy breakfast item of eggs scrambled in butter with sriracha and half-and-half.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon sriracha sauce, or to taste
salt and ground pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Beat eggs in a bowl with half-and-half, sriracha, salt, and pepper until smooth.

Melt butter in nonstick pan over medium-low heat, tilting the pan to cover surface entirely with butter. Cook egg mixture in pan, stirring to slowly scramble eggs, until the eggs are fully set, 3 to 5 minutes.
